notes.title: Achievements Progress Update
notes.content:
Hello everyone! As mentioned, achievements will be coming soon to CUBEMATRIX. However, due to University finals and the production of our second game with the new Unity Team, I have yet to be able to implement them fully.

I have been able to integrate the achievement system in Unity and plan to create them after finals and send them out as a major update. Thank you all for your patience and I hope to bring you all the content soon!
